comparison.objective: Open a bottle by lowering a detented safety loop and actuating a separate rocker latch.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize a free bottle while sequentially manipulating two spring-loaded restraints.
comparison.success_condition: Lid opens beyond 60 degrees while the bottle stays upright, supported, within force limits, and manipulated only by robot contact.
comparison.reason: Sequential latch manipulation on a free bottle does not test fine tool insertion, movable-socket reacquisition, or iterative impact adjustment.
